_note: Synthetic, general-purpose coaching cues written for this project. Not clinically sourced; not medical advice.

cues: Feet about shoulder-width, toes turned out slightly
Brace your stomach like you're about to be poked
Knees travel in the same direction as your toes
Keep your chest proud and your whole foot on the floor
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom
squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, hold it on the way down, breathe out as you stand up.

cues: Take a long enough step that both knees can bend to about 90°
Keep your torso tall
Push through the front heel to come up
Hold something for balance if you need to
mistakes: Slamming the back knee into the floor
lunge.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, breathe out as you push back up.

cues: Adjust the seat so the joint lines up with the machine's pivot
Sit all the way back against the pad
Move smoothly. Don't let the weights crash
Start light: the stack is easy to adjust
mistakes: Locking the knees hard at the end
Lifting your hips off the seat
legmachine.breathing: Breathe out as you push, breathe in as you return.

cues: Balls of the feet on the edge of the step
Rise as high as you can and pause
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch
calf.breathing: Breathe out going up, in coming down.
calf.tempo: Up 1 s · pause 1 s · down 2 s

cues: Push your hips back like closing a car door with your bum
Keep the weight close to your legs
Back flat from head to hips
Stand up by squeezing your glutes
mistakes: Turning it into a squat by bending the knees too much
hinge.breathing: Big breath and brace before each rep; breathe out at the top.

cues: Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down
Drive through the heels
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top for a second
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using the hips
glute.breathing: Breathe out as the hips rise, in as they lower.
glute.tempo: Up 1 s · hold 1 s · down 2 s

cues: Land softly and quietly on the balls of your feet
Knees bend as you land
Rest fully between sets: quality over quantity
jump.breathing: Quick breath out on each effort.

cues: Shoulder blades pulled back and down into the pad
Feet flat on the floor
Lower to the middle of your chest
Elbows at about 45° from your body, not flared
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off your chest
Lifting your bum off the bench
press.breathing: Breathe in on the way down, breathe out as you press.

cues: Body in a straight line from head to heels
Hands just outside shoulder-width
Lower until your chest is close to the floor (or elbows at 90°)
mistakes: Going lower than your shoulders are comfortable with
bodypress.breathing: Breathe in going down, out as you push up.
bodypress.dose: 3 sets of as many good reps as you can (stop 2 before failure)

cues: Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach
Press straight up and finish with arms by your ears
Move your head back slightly to let the weight pass
overhead.breathing: Breathe in at the bottom, out as you press.

cues: Use a light weight: these muscles are small
Slight bend in the elbows the whole time
Lift with control and stop at shoulder height
raise.breathing: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.

cues: Pull your elbows back toward your hips
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end
Keep your chest up and back flat
mistakes: Jerking the weight with your lower back
row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull, in as you return.
row.tempo: Pull 1 s · squeeze 1 s · return 2 s

cues: Start by pulling your shoulders down, away from your ears
Drive your elbows down to your sides
Bring your chest toward the bar
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck
Letting the shoulders shrug up at the bottom
vertical.breathing: Breathe out as you pull, in as you lower.
vertical.dose: 3 sets of 8–10 reps (use assistance if needed)

cues: Elbows stay pinned at your sides
Curl up, squeeze, then lower slowly
Stand tall, no leaning back
mistakes: Swinging the weight with your back
curl.breathing: Breathe out as you curl, in as you lower.

cues: Upper arms stay still: only the elbows move
Straighten the arm fully and squeeze
Control the way back
mistakes: Using your body weight to push
Going so heavy the shoulders take over
triceps.breathing: Breathe out as you straighten, in as you bend.

cues: Ribs pulled down toward your hips
Lower back stays neutral, not arched
Move slowly; it's about control, not speed
core.breathing: Keep breathing steadily; breathe out on the hardest part.
core.dose: 3 sets of 20–30 s holds or 10–12 reps

cues: Turn from your upper back while the hips stay steady
Arms stay long
Move smoothly from side to side
Stand tall like a string pulls your head up
Short, steady steps
Shoulders down, grip tight
carry.breathing: Short, steady breaths while you stay braced.

cues: Start with 5 minutes easy to warm up
You should still be able to talk in short sentences
Stand or sit tall, relaxed shoulders
mistakes: Holding onto the rails the whole time
cardio.breathing: Breathe rhythmically through the nose and mouth.
